title: hedera helix var. canariensis
intro: Hedera helix var. canariensis, commonly known as the Canary Island ivy or Madeira ivy, is a variety of the evergreen climber Hedera helix. It is known for its heart-shaped leaves and ability to thrive in a wide range of environments. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support health and wellbeing, with reported health benefits including stress relief and improved sleep quality due to its anxiolytic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in Hedera helix var. canariensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
